name: LucyN
notice: USING LUCYN REQUIRES YOU TO BUILD IT ON YOUR OWN MACHINE. We have no servers that can build LucyN for you, let alone host the builds: CEF (Chromium Embedded Framework) is about 1.5 GB per platform and 3+ GB unpacked, which is too big for GitHub Actions and far too big for us to publish for every OS and CPU architecture. Every release is the source code, zipped - nothing is compiled and no CEF is included. Fetch the CEF build listed above, then build with CMake.
